# as_votebkm — Plugify port of the Pisex admin_system module "[AS] VoteBKM" (player votes for
# ban / kick / mute / gag).
#
#   plugify-as_votebkm  the plugin shared library (entry "bin/as_votebkm" -> bin/libas_votebkm.so)

set(AS_VOTEBKM_VERSION "1.0.2")

# The __s2sdk_* / __admin_system_* binding slots are defined by the object libraries below and
# filled by the plugify module from the plugins declared as dependencies. The admin_system
# consumer bindings are generated by bin/plugify-gen; plugins/admin_system/CMakeLists.txt owns
# that object library.
if(NOT TARGET admin_system_bindings_obj)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "as_votebkm needs the generated admin_system consumer bindings (plugins/admin_system/include/external/plugify/include/admin_system/admin_system.cpp)")
endif()

add_library(plugify-as_votebkm SHARED
        src/plugin.cpp
        $<TARGET_OBJECTS:s2sdk_bindings>
        $<TARGET_OBJECTS:admin_system_bindings_obj>
)
target_include_directories(plugify-as_votebkm PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
# SYSTEM: warnings from the generated plg/s2sdk/admin_system headers must not fail -Werror on our sources.
target_include_directories(plugify-as_votebkm SYSTEM PRIVATE
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugins/admin_system/include"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/plugins/admin_system/include/external/plugify/include"
)
target_link_libraries(plugify-as_votebkm PRIVATE
        pisexcompat
        -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc
)
target_compile_options(plugify-as_votebkm PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_compile_definitions(plugify-as_votebkm PRIVATE
        _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1
        PLUGIFY_MODULE="as_votebkm"
        PLUGIFY_IS_DEBUG=0
        PLUGIFY_IS_RELEASE=1
)
set_target_properties(plugify-as_votebkm PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME as_votebkm)

if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    target_link_options(plugify-as_votebkm PRIVATE
            "-Wl,--version-script,${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sym/version_script.lds")
endif()

configure_file(
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/as_votebkm.pplugin.in"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/as_votebkm.pplugin"
)
